title: Move-in-date upper-bound E2E scenario broken: {MOVE_IN_DATE} (today+90d) can never trigger the expected validation_error
evidence:
name: desired_move_in_date more than 12 months out is rejected
expected_outcome: validation_error
expected_error_fields:
  - desired_move_in_date
  desired_move_in_date: "{MOVE_IN_DATE}"  — and SKILL.md:279: "Only the boundary-validation scenarios (`desired-move-in-date-in-past`, `-too-far-future`) pin literal dates on purpose." and SKILL.md:172: "`{MOVE_IN_DATE}` → today + 90 days as YYYY-MM-DD"; application_handler.gleam:1114: "Validate `desired_move_in_date` against today + a 12-month ceiling."
detail: The diff replaced the pinned 2030-01-01 with {MOVE_IN_DATE} (today+90d), which is inside the server's 12-month ceiling, so the upper-bound branch of validate_move_in_date is never exercised: the scenario is permanently red, inviting a 'fix' that silently deletes the boundary-validation coverage the diff's own SKILL.md says to pin.
recommended_fix: Restore a literal far-future date (e.g. 2030-01-01, per the scenario's own yearly-maintenance note) in desired-move-in-date-too-far-future.yaml so it keeps pinning the +12-month rejection branch.
